trigger: A DR200 ISO 10000 night scene converted with -161 percent physical extra vignetting showed dark rings around point lights.

root_cause.derivation: The old output was gain*blur(signal) + noise_scale*(signal-blur(signal)). Immediately outside a positive point impulse the residual is negative. Because noise_scale is greater than gain for 0<gain<1, the added term is (gain-noise_scale)*blur(signal), a deterministic negative halo.
not_leading_causes: lateral CA profile offsets are below 0.00031 in the admitted RAF
the current sidecar USM amount is zero
the black ring exists in the RAW-domain physical-vignette construction before Phocus highlight recovery

replacement.photometry: attenuate each CFA signal sample pointwise by radial gain
replacement.noise_source: deterministic independent PCG64 stream per full CFA plane, seeded from source SHA-256

claim_boundary: The v2 construction removes the deterministic frequency-split halo and matches the first two moments of a shot-plus-read approximation. It is not a calibrated GFX100RF per-ISO photon-transfer model. A full-quality Phocus render and first-attempt HNNR remain release gates.
